facts.name: FieldActionGlobal_RefreshShootingTargets_LeaderNear261
facts.note: (global): when the global's wanted byte +0x389 is set, clears it, copies the registered shooting-target list under its lock and writes every target's leader-near byte (1.004 +0x261, 1.005 +0x259) from the party leader's (PM+0x148) root location. Entry %16=0 in 1.004, %16=12 in 1.005; called, never redirected.
